description: CR 205.3i / 305.6 Tribal Flames deals damage equal to the basic land types among alice's lands, counting a Tundra twice and a Desert and bob's Mountain not at all
note: Alice's lands are two Forests, a Tundra (Island Plains) and a Desert: three basic land types. Counting lands gives 4, counting every land type gives 4, and counting every player's lands gives 4 (bob's Mountain), so only the domain count leaves bob at 17. The red mana floats, so no Mountain of alice's adds a type.
